item.title: Pulitzer Prize-winning correspondent Peter Arnett, who reported on Vietnam and Gulf wars, has died
item.description: LOS ANGELES (AP) — Peter Arnett, the Pulitzer Prize-winning reporter who spent decades dodging bullets and bombs to bring the world eyewitness accounts of war from the rice paddies of Vietnam to the deserts of Iraq, has died. He was 91.

item.title: Local PWHL stars hope Takeover Tour in Halifax inspires next generation
item.description: HALIFAX — When Toronto Sceptres captain Blayre Turnbull grew up playing hockey in Stellarton, N.S., she didn’t look up to any professional women's players — because they didn’t exist.

item.title: World's tallest teen, Olivier Rioux of Canada, delivers emphatic dunk for first college field goal
item.description: GAINESVILLE, Fla. (AP) — Olivier Rioux lumbered through the lane, caught a bounce pass from teammate CJ Ingram and dunked, sending Florida’s bench and the home crowd into a frenzy. Rioux barely left his feet to make it happen.

item.title: Alex Carpenter has 2 goals, 1 assist, Torrent beats Charge 4-1
item.description: SEATTLE (AP) — Alex Carpenter had two goals and an assist, Hannah Bilka added a goal and two assists, and the Seattle Torrent beat the Ottawa Charge 4-1 on Wednesday night for their second consecutive win.

item.title: DND acquires 52-unit apartment in Courtenay for military members
item.description: The $19.1-million complex on Cumberland Road is expected to be ready to provide housing for 19 Wing Comox next summer.

item.title: Bowker Creek overflows as heavy rain floods roads, basements
item.description: Saanich received 81 calls for service from 7 p.m. to midnight on Tuesday, while Victoria public works dealt with over 50 calls for everything from flooding to downed trees.

item.title: Victoria shops tackle street disorder with a little help from their neighbours
item.description: Business owners on the 700 block of Fort Street are using a newly created WhatsApp group chat to share information, as part of an initiative by the Downtown Victoria Business Association.
